Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified the magnetic properties of the materials involved. It falsely claimed that aluminum is paramagnetic and weakly attracted by horseshoe magnets, whereas aluminum is actually diamagnetic and is not attracted to magnets. Furthermore, it incorrectly stated that many common steel screws are non-magnetic (austenitic stainless steel is indeed non-magnetic, but standard carbon steel screws, which are the most common type of "steel screw" in general contexts, are ferromagnetic and strongly attracted to magnets). Because of these fundamental physics errors, the Planner concluded that magnetic separation (Option C) is unreliable and chose the incorrect Option B (screen filter). The correct answer is C, as a magnet will easily separate ferromagnetic steel screws from non-magnetic aluminum screws.
